reading: Two pen drawings of the same house with a person at work at a desk. Left, repaint: a crack runs from the old footing up the wall, and a paint roller covers the wall and the person's middle with an AI agent; the crack below stays. Right, renovate: the same house and the same person, on a new foundation.
sourceNote: No numbers. The labels follow the topic proposal of 2 November 2026 (Figure 1: 'Repaint: an agent added to the old structure'; 'every layer inspected, renewed and documented'; the specialist is 'reassigned, retrained') and the thesis of 16 November 2026 (workers enabled, not replaced).

repaint.head: Repaint
repaint.note: an AI agent painted over the old structure

renovate.head: Renovate
renovate.note: renewed from the foundation up; the person at work stays
